## About
Roland's Precision Machine is an owner operated shop in Alvin serving the surrounding Tri-County Area. We do complete automotive repair and precision engine machining under one roof.
We work on foreign and domestic cars, trucks and diesel, sports cars, classic hot rods, and farm and tractor equipment. If it's an internal combustion engine, we can build it the way you want, with parts you bring or parts we find to fit your budget.
Customers tell us they like sitting down with Roland to talk through a build before ordering parts. Give us a call and come see what we can do.

## Services
- Engine rebuild and install: No matter the make or model, we can rebuild your engine and put it back in your vehicle.
- Precision engine machining: Factory and high performance machining and assembly, built to your specifications.
- Auto repair: Complete auto care in one location.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring my own parts?
A: Yes. We'll use the parts you provide to your specs, or we can source parts to fit your budget.

Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Estimates are free, and so are A/C checks.

Q: Do you work with fleets?
A: Yes. We handle fleet accounts with competitive discounted pricing.
